messages.subject: NIMBLE version 1.4.3 released
parts:
We've released version 1.4.3 of nimble.

This is a micro release that:

  •  fixes a bug causing incorrect results when using the prior_samples MCMC sampler,
  • makes some internal changes requested by CRAN, and
  • fixes various corner cases.
Please see the NEWS file in the installed package for more details.

- Chris Paciorek for the NIMBLE Development Team
